typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{Container Number} as string,
		Facility as string,
		Complex as string,
		Yard as string,
		{Carrier Visit Key} as string,
		Service as string,
		{Inbound Carrier} as string,
		{Inbound Service} as string,
		{Intended Outbound Carrier} as string,
		{Actual Outbound Carrier} as string,
		{Actual Outbound Service} as string,
		{Intended Outbound Service} as string,
		{Arrival Mode} as string,
		{Visit State} as string,
		{Transit State} as string,
		{VGM Kg} as string,
		{Container Length} as string,
		{IMDG Code} as string,
		{Hazard UN Numbers} as string,
		Hazardous as string,
		{Current Position} as string,
		{Equipment Type} as string,
		{Equipment Class} as string,
		{Special Stow 1} as string,
		{Special Stow 2} as string,
		{Special Stow 3} as string,
		{Event Type} as string,
		{Move Type} as string,
		{From Location Type} as string,
		{From Position} as string,
		{To Location Type} as string,
		{To Position} as string,
		POD as string,
		POL as string,
		{Stacking Factor} as string,
		{Section Factor} as string,
		{MFT Classification} as string,
		{Weight Class} as string,
		Category as string,
		{Freight Kind} as string,
		{Container Weight Kg} as string,
		Reefer as string,
		OOG as string,
		{Fetch Time} as string,
		{Put Time} as string,
		{Dispatch Time} as string,
		{Discharge Time} as string,
		{Carry Dispatch Time} as string,
		{Carry Fetch Ready} as string,
		{Carry Put Ready} as string,
		{Carry Complete Time} as string,
		{Fetch Operator} as string,
		{Fetch CHE} as string,
		{Fetch CHE Type} as string,
		{Carry Operator} as string,
		{Carry CHE} as string,
		{Carry CHE Type} as string,
		{Put Operator} as string,
		{Put CHE} as string,
		{Put CHE Type} as string,
		{QC CHE} as string,
		{QC CHE Type} as string,
		{Twin Fetch} as string,
		{Twin Carry} as string,
		{Twin Put} as string,
		{Start Distance} as string,
		{Carry Distance} as string,
		{From Position Gkey} as string,
		{To Position Gkey} as string,
		{Restow Reason} as string,
		{Rehandle Count} as string,
		{Container Line} as string,
		{Container Line Role} as string,
		Berth as string,
		POW as string,
		Shipper as string,
		Consignee as string,
		Commodity as string,
		{Carrier ATA} as string,
		{Carrier ATD} as string,
		{Move Event Gkey} as string,
		{Unit Visit Gkey} as string,
		{Active UFV} as string
	),
	useSchema: false,
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	moveFiles: ['bronze/moves/load','bronze/moves/archive'],
	format: 'delimited',
	fileSystem: 'malta',
	folderPath: 'bronze/moves/load',
	columnDelimiter: ',',
	escapeChar: '\\',
	quoteChar: '\"',
	columnNamesAsHeader: true,
	dateFormats: ['dd-MM-yyyy'],
	timestampFormats: ['yyyy-MM-dd\'T\'HH:mm:ss.SSS\'Z\'','yyyy-MM-dd\'T\'HH:mm:ss\'Z\'']) ~> CSV
Aggregate1 derive(t_carry_complete = coalesce(toTimestamp(t_carry_complete,'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_carry_complete,'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_carry_complete,'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp(t_carry_complete,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp(t_carry_complete,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_carry_complete,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm')),
		t_put = coalesce(toTimestamp(t_put,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(t_put,'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_put,'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_put,'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp(t_put,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp(t_put,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_put,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		t_fetch = coalesce(toTimestamp(t_fetch,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(t_fetch,'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_fetch,'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_fetch,'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp(t_fetch,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp(t_fetch,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_fetch,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		t_discharge = coalesce(toTimestamp(t_discharge,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(t_discharge,'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_discharge,'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_discharge,'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp(t_discharge,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp(t_discharge,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_discharge,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		Fetch_CHE_Id = toLong(Fetch_CHE_Id),
		QC_CHE_Id = toLong(QC_CHE_Id),
		Put_CHE_Id = toLong(Put_CHE_Id),
		Carry_CHE_Id = toLong(Carry_CHE_Id),
		Year = year(coalesce(toTimestamp(t_put,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(t_put,'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_put,'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_put,'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp(t_put,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp(t_put,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_put,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'))),
		Month = month(coalesce(toTimestamp(t_put,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(t_put,'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_put,'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_put,'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp(t_put,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp(t_put,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_put,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'))),
		Week = weekOfYear(coalesce(toTimestamp(t_put,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(t_put,'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_put,'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_put,'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp(t_put,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp(t_put,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_put,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'))),
		t_dispatch = coalesce(toTimestamp(t_dispatch,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(t_dispatch,'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_dispatch,'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_dispatch,'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp(t_dispatch,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp(t_dispatch,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_dispatch,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		t_carry_dispatch = coalesce(toTimestamp(t_carry_dispatch,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(t_carry_dispatch,'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_carry_dispatch,'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_carry_dispatch,'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp(t_carry_dispatch,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp(t_carry_dispatch,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_carry_dispatch,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		t_carry_fetch_ready = coalesce(toTimestamp(t_carry_fetch_ready,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(t_carry_fetch_ready,'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_carry_fetch_ready,'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_carry_fetch_ready,'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp(t_carry_fetch_ready,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp(t_carry_fetch_ready,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_carry_fetch_ready,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		t_carry_put_ready = coalesce(toTimestamp(t_carry_put_ready,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(t_carry_put_ready,'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_carry_put_ready,'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_carry_put_ready,'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp(t_carry_put_ready,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp(t_carry_put_ready,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(t_carry_put_ready,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		ATD = coalesce(toTimestamp(ATD,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(ATD,'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(ATD,'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(ATD,'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp(ATD,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp(ATD,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(ATD,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		ATA = coalesce(toTimestamp(ATA,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(ATA,'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(ATA,'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(ATA,'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp(ATA,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp(ATA,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(ATA,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'))) ~> DataTypeConversion
Select2 select(mapColumn(
		each(match(true()),
			regexReplace($$,' ','_') = $$)
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
Select1 aggregate(groupBy(mve_gkey),
	each(match(name!='mve_gkey'), $$ = first($$))) ~> Aggregate1
CSV select(mapColumn(
		{Unit Nbr} = {Container Number},
		{Facility Id} = Facility,
		{Complex Id} = Complex,
		{Yard Id} = Yard,
		{Carrier Visit Key},
		{Carrier Service} = Service,
		{Event Type Id} = {Event Type},
		{Move Kind} = {Move Type},
		{From Location} = {From Location Type},
		{To Location} = {To Location Type},
		{From Position Name} = {From Position},
		{To Position Name} = {To Position},
		{Carry CHE Operator Id} = {Carry Operator},
		{Fetch CHE Operator Id} = {Fetch Operator},
		{Put CHE Operator Id} = {Put Operator},
		{Fetch CHE Id} = {Fetch CHE},
		{Fetch CHE Kind} = {Fetch CHE Type},
		{Carry CHE Id} = {Carry CHE},
		{Carry CHE Kind} = {Carry CHE Type},
		{Put CHE Id} = {Put CHE},
		{Put CHE Kind} = {Put CHE Type},
		{QC CHE Id} = {QC CHE},
		{QC CHE Kind} = {QC CHE Type},
		t_carry_complete = {Carry Complete Time},
		t_put = {Put Time},
		t_fetch = {Fetch Time},
		t_dispatch = {Dispatch Time},
		t_discharge = {Discharge Time},
		t_carry_dispatch = {Carry Dispatch Time},
		t_carry_fetch_ready = {Carry Fetch Ready},
		t_carry_put_ready = {Carry Put Ready},
		dist_carry = {Carry Distance},
		dist_start = {Start Distance},
		{Twin Fetch},
		{Twin Carry},
		{Twin Put},
		{Category Id} = Category,
		{Freight Kind Id} = {Freight Kind},
		to_pos_gkey = {To Position Gkey},
		fm_pos_gkey = {From Position Gkey},
		{Restow Reason},
		{Container Line Id} = {Container Line},
		{Container Line Role},
		pow = POW,
		mve_gkey = {Move Event Gkey},
		ufv_gkey = {Unit Visit Gkey},
		{Berth Id} = Berth,
		{Goods And Ctr Wt Kg} = {Container Weight Kg},
		active_ufv = {Active UFV},
		{Requires Power Flag} = Reefer,
		{OOG Flag} = OOG,
		{Unit POD} = POD,
		{Shipper Id} = Shipper,
		{Consignee Id} = Consignee,
		{Commodity Id} = Commodity,
		ATD = {Carrier ATD},
		Rehandles = {Rehandle Count},
		ATA = {Carrier ATA},
		{Inbound Carrier},
		{Inbound Service},
		{Intended Outbound Carrier},
		{Actual Outbound Carrier},
		{Actual Outbound Service},
		{Intended Outbound Service},
		{Arrival Mode},
		{Visit State},
		{Transit State},
		{VGM Kg},
		{Container Length},
		{IMDG Code},
		{Hazard UN Numbers},
		Hazardous,
		{Current Position},
		{Equipment Type},
		{Equipment Class},
		{Special Stow 1},
		{Special Stow 2},
		{Special Stow 3},
		POL,
		{Stacking Factor},
		{Section Factor},
		{MFT Classification},
		{Weight Class}
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
DataTypeConversion alterRow(upsertIf(true())) ~> AlterRow1
AlterRow1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	format: 'delta',
	fileSystem: 'malta',
	folderPath: 'silver/moves',
	mergeSchema: true,
	autoCompact: true,
	optimizedWrite: true,
	vacuum: 0,
	deletable: false,
	insertable: false,
	updateable: false,
	upsertable: true,
	keys:['mve_gkey'],
	umask: 0777,
	preCommands: [],
	postCommands: [],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('key',
		0,
		Year,
		Month,
		Week
	)) ~> sink2
